Matt S: Heads-up — Peregrine Labs (trial) hit a provisioning/activation snag. Customer can't fetch API keys, onboarding stalled, renewal touchpoint next week. Opening escalation to CS. Support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-9142 :warning:
Elaine R: copying Sarah — high priority. Can you paste the failure logs and the provisioning request id? Do we have customer time for a call today? :eyes:
Sarah (CSM): I can own. Pinged customer for 2pm PST slot. What error do they see in console?
Matt S: From support ticket: 
```
2026-03-20T18:02:13Z ERROR provisioning: missing SAML attribute 'email' for account peregrine-42
request_id=req_0a9f
```
They tried SSO first; fallback to API key flow fails with 403.
Ivan (AE): Renewal is on 2026-03-27. If we don't get them live by EOD 3/24 it's a risk to commit. I can join the call to discuss commercial options.
Tara - Ops: Short-term mitigation: we can issue a temporary API key from the internal console and email it to the customer for manual onboarding. Approving a temp key requires one ops + CS sign-off. Command to generate:
```
/redwoodctl keys create --account peregrine-42 --ttl 48h --reason "temp-onboard"
```
Sarah (CSM): Template for customer email draft — please edit:
"Hi <name>, we've provisioned a temporary API key so you can continue testing while we fix SSO. Joining a 30m call would help us finalize attributes."
Elaine R: Proposed comms plan: (1) Send templated email within 1 hour, (2) 30m troubleshooting call within 4 hours, (3) Ops provide temp key within 2 hours of call, (4) Escalate to eng-runtime if not fixed in 8 hours. Assign owner: Sarah. :thumbsup:
Matt S: I've added support logs to the ticket and linked the prod error. Support suggests attribute mapping issue on Peregrine's IdP.
CS Bot: New escalation ticket created: ESK-2026-197 — assigned to customer-success queue.
Sarah (CSM): I'll send the email now and schedule the 2pm PST call. Ivan — can you prepare the renewal notes? I'll include a risk line.
Ivan (AE): On it. Also cc finance if we need to extend trial.
Tara - Ops: If CS confirms call and we need temp key, @Tara - Ops will run the create command and paste the key in a secure DM. :lock:
Elaine R: Good plan. Escalation matrix: if no resolution by 8 hours -> bring in eng-runtime + eng-platform. I'll update the playbook. Sarah, assigned to you as primary.
Matt S: Thanks all — Sarah please ping me if eng involvement required. :pray:
